description: This file is a PHP unit test class for testing the SuiteCRM Exception class. It contains test methods for verifying the default detail message and log level of an Exception instance.

classes.name: ExceptionTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing SuiteCRM's Exception class behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test by creating a singleton instance of the Exception class for testing.

methods.name: testGetDetail
methods.description: Asserts that the default detail message of the Exception is as expected.

methods.name: testGetLogLevel
methods.description: Asserts that the log level of the Exception is LogLevel::CRITICAL.
